body-strong.purpose: Field labels, secondary button labels, Downloads heading, row titles.

body.purpose: Field text, placeholders, checkbox label, menu items.

label.purpose: Hints, byline, counts, notice text, footer, links, compact buttons.

shadows.name: product-shot
shadows.purpose: Website screenshot only (dark: 0 18px 44px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 4px 12px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)). The app has no shadows.

motion.name: control-fill
motion.purpose: Website button background and border transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All website transitions off under prefers-reduced-motion. The app itself has no animation; notices auto-hide after reading time plus 2s.

focus.name: field-focus
focus.purpose: Entries on focus; invalid entries keep a 1px danger border.

focus.name: control-ring
focus.value: border 2px #2563EB on neutral controls, 2px ink on blue-filled controls
focus.purpose: Keyboard focus on CustomTkinter buttons via make_focusable.

focus.name: link-focus
focus.purpose: Text links show their hover underline while focused.

platformExceptions: Dark-mode Action Blue stays #2563EB for white-text contrast; only text links lighten to #60A5FA.
System UI faces (Segoe UI Variable / Segoe UI / macOS system face) instead of a bundled typeface.
Hairlines are 1px CTkFrames with bg_color set, because CustomTkinter skips drawing 1px frames.
Placeholders are overlay CTkLabels, because CustomTkinter hides placeholders on variable-bound entries.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one full-width Download action; blue fill, white download glyph, 46px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-width: 320px; height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #2563EB; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 15px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #111827; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral 40px button attached to a field (Paste, Change…).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 40px; min-width: 92px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111827; font: 600 13px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F3F4F6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 2px solid #2563EB; padding: 0 13px; }

components.name: Row Action
components.description: The single action in a download row; neutral, or blue only for the sign-in recovery step.
components.css: .ds-row-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-row { height: 30px; min-width: 96px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111827; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-row:hover { background: #F3F4F6; } .ds-btn-row--next { border-color: #2563EB; background: #2563EB; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-row--next:hover { background: #1D4ED8; border-color: #1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-row:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 2px solid #2563EB; } .ds-btn-row--next:focus-visible { border-color: #111827; }

components.name: Link Field
components.description: 40px entry with a muted placeholder; 2px blue border on focus, danger border and message when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 360px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111827; font: 400 13px inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7280; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border: 2px solid #2563EB; padding: 0 7px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: #DC2626; } .ds-field-hint { min-height: 20px; font-size: 12px; color: #6B7280; }

components.name: Exact Cut Checkbox
components.description: 18px box with 4px corners, strong border off, blue fill on; muted hint to its right.
components.css: .ds-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 13px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #111827; } .ds-check input { appearance: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: 0; border: 2px solid #9CA3AF; border-radius: 4px; display: grid; place-content: center; } .ds-check input:checked { background: #2563EB; border-color: #2563EB; } .ds-check input:checked::after { content: ''; width: 5px; height: 9px; border: solid #FFFFFF; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; transform: translateY(-1px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-check input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #2563EB; } .ds-check small { margin-left: 2px; font-size: 12px; color: #6B7280; }

components.name: Notice Banner
components.description: Tinted, bordered in-place message with a glyph and dismiss; replaces dialogs and toasts.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 6px 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #BFDBFE; border-radius: 8px; background: #EFF6FF; font: 400 12px/1.45 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #111827; } .ds-notice svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; margin-top: 1px; } .ds-notice p { margin: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-notice-close { width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #4B5563; cursor: pointer; } .ds-notice-close:hover { background: #E5E7EB; } .ds-notice-close:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #2563EB; }

narrative.overview:
Clipify is the downloader window everyone already knows how to use: one link field, one blue button, a list of downloads. It earns its place by finish rather than invention. Platform neutrals carry the whole window, a single action blue marks the one thing to press, and every job's progress, result and next step lives in place in the list, never in a toast or a modal. The quality bar is Downie on macOS.

Density is compact desktop: a resizable window around 720×600, 13px body text, 40px controls, 24px page margins, hairlines instead of cards. The website at docs/ is the same world in CSS: the same neutrals, the same blue, the same system faces, the same 6px controls, scaled up for reading.

The system rejects two named failure modes: the grey system dialog with no hierarchy, and template SaaS (lavender cards and pills, as in the 1.x window).
keyCharacteristics: White (or #1E1F22 graphite) window, cool gray ink ladder, one action blue.
System UI faces only; weight and size carry hierarchy, never colour.
1px borders and hairlines, 6px controls, 8px containers, no shadows inside the app.
Status is spoken by a 14px glyph plus a coloured line of text, not by chips or badges.
Every light value has a dark twin; the window follows the system theme.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Action Blue fills exactly one kind of thing: the action the person should take next. One full-width Download button per window; inside the list, a row action turns blue only when it is the recovery step (sign in). Retry, Cancel, Remove and Show in folder stay neutral.

rules.name: The Paired Token Rule
rules.body: No colour enters the app as a single value. Every token is a (light, dark) pair in `ytclip/theme.py`, and icon glyph colours are derived from the same pairs (`ICON_TONES`) so baked PNGs cannot drift from the palette.

rules.name: The Semibold Family Rule
rules.body: On Windows 11 the strong roles use the named Semibold family ("Segoe UI Variable Text Semibold"), not `weight="bold"` on the variable face; Tk would otherwise synthesize a heavier bold. Bold weight is used only when no Semibold family exists.

rules.name: The Two-Step Ramp Rule
rules.body: The app's ramp is 12 / 13 / 15 / 20. A new size must justify itself against these four.

rules.name: The Line Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Separation is a hairline or a 1px border. If something needs to stand apart inside the window, it gets a border or a tonal fill, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Drawn Hairline Rule
rules.body: CustomTkinter skips drawing frames 1px tall, so a hairline is a 1px frame whose `bg_color` is set to the hairline colour as well as its `fg_color`. Use the `hairline()` helper; never a 1px frame with `fg_color` alone.

dos: **Do** take every colour from the (light, dark) pairs in `ytclip/theme.py`; add a new token as a pair or not at all.
**Do** keep Action Blue at #2563EB in dark mode for filled controls, and use Link Blue (#60A5FA) only for text on graphite.
**Do** use the system faces through `Typography` and the 12 / 13 / 15 / 20 ramp; use the numeric face for live figures.
**Do** draw 1px rules with the `hairline()` helper and placeholders with the overlay label.
**Do** give every focusable control a visible 2px focus state and Enter/Space activation.
**Do** report outcomes in place: a glyph and a status line in the row, a notice banner above the list.
**Do** size buttons and labels for the Russian copy, which runs longer than English.
donts: **Don't** add a second filled-blue button to a view; row recovery actions are the only exception.
**Don't** introduce toasts, modals or pills for status.
**Don't** bundle a display or text typeface; the system faces are the decision.
**Don't** rebuild the lavender cards and pills of the 1.x window, or flatten the window into a grey dialog with no hierarchy.
**Don't** mix icon sets or weights; new glyphs come from Bootstrap Icons through `GLYPHS` in `scripts/generate_icon.py`.
